create_directory: create a directory at a given path if it does not already exist using mkdir
create_multiple_directories: create multiple directories from a list of paths using mkdirs
refactor_mkdir: refactor the mkdir function to use os.makedirs with exist_ok instead of a manual check
review_mkdirs: review the mkdirs function to handle both single paths and lists of paths
test_mkdir: test the mkdir function to ensure it creates directories only when they do not exist
